cases.prompt: Audit why AI answer engines don't cite us. Product: Ledgerly, invoicing software for German freelancers. Priority questions: 'how do I issue an XRechnung as a freelancer' and 'best invoicing software for freelancers in Germany'. Baseline on 2026-09-10 from a Berlin IP, logged prompts, fresh sessions: ChatGPT search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews each asked both questions twice; Ledgerly cited 0 of 12, competitor Rechnio cited 8 of 12, always its /xrechnung-guide page, which has a numbered step list, a named tax advisor as author, and 'updated 2026-08'. Our /features/e-invoicing page is rendered client-side: curl returns an empty <div id="root">. It has no author, no update date, and says 'fully compliant' without citing the standard.
sourceAnchors: Compare cited competitors at the passage and source level.
Inspect crawl and rendering access, canonical identity, authorship, update signals

requiredEvidence: client-side rendering hides content from crawlers
competitor cited for step list passage
